verdicts.reason: Both banners are nearly identical, and both fail in the same way. The hands photo, which is the key image, is gone except for a stray black sliver at the top edge. The quote sits flat on plain white, and the attribution floats far off to the right with no link to the quote. The cross motif is clipped against the right edge as a faint smudge. Almost no trace of the original's dark, moody feel survives in either version.
